summary: Alpha Compute Corp (Nasdaq: ALP), a BVI-domiciled GPU-as-a-service and AI compute company, filed a Form 6-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing definitive real estate and asset purchase agreements to acquire over 300 acres of surface, mineral and gas rights in Pennsylvania spanning the Utica and Marcellus shale formations, plus more than 75 existing oil and gas wells, pump jacks, maintenance facilities, heavy equipment and gathering infrastructure for US$5.5 million. The company intends to develop a data center on the site, subject to county ordinances, Pennsylvania DEP regulations and regional grid interconnection. The filing is a foreign private issuer current report equivalent to a US Form 8-K; no board recommendation, advisor, financing or closing timetable was disclosed. Watch whether the deal closes, reserve appraisals validate the Haliburton estimate, and whether permitting or capital constraints delay the data-center build.
